description: Query PhaseFolio benchmark availability. Source-backed PoS benchmarks are available separately; network cost distributions and duration percentiles are planned but currently return coming_soon with null estimates rather than PhaseFolio's manual planning defaults.

indication.description: Indication name (e.g. 'NSCLC', 'Rheumatoid Arthritis', 'Atopic Dermatitis'). Free-form; the engine fuzz-matches to the canonical indication taxonomy.

metric.description: Which benchmark family to request. Cost and duration network benchmarks are currently coming_soon and return no estimate; manual wizard defaults are not returned as benchmarks.

modality.description: Optional modality filter ('Antibody', 'Small Molecule', 'Cell Therapy', 'Gene Therapy', etc.). Omit to return cross-modality stats.

name: query_benchmarks

outputSchema.description: Canonical PhaseFolio envelope. Substantive payload is in `data`.

data.description: L1 (no-auth) returns a versioned headline set; L3 (bearer) will return granular slices once enough orgs are on the network.

available_metrics.description: Network benchmark metric families with published numeric estimates.

coming_soon.description: Set when this metric family hasn't published yet; explains when it will.

headlines.description: Headline aggregates returned at the public tier.

metric.description: Metric name, e.g. 'Phase II RA trial cost (median, USD M)'.

n.description: Sample size behind the value; null when status='coming_soon'.

methodology_url.description: Path to the methodology section that explains how these were computed.

planning_defaults_excluded.description: True when manual PhaseFolio planning defaults are intentionally excluded.

version.description: Stable version identifier of this benchmark snapshot, e.g. 'preview-2026-04'.
